title: Fine Arts Travel Fee Schedule — Trip Shares by Performance Trips Remaining at Registration, Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees
content:
A trip share applies to the Fine Arts travel fee of **Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees** for a Fine Arts Performing Ensemble participation for the 2026-27 school year whose registration date is after 2026-08-03, by the number of the ensemble's four trips that fall on or after the registration date: with one or none, the share is 30 percent for each such trip; with two or three, the share is that number of trips out of four, as a percentage; and otherwise the full travel fee is due (100 percent).

| Ensemble | Performance trips of the 2026-27 school year |
|---|---|
| band and orchestra | 2026-10-24, 2026-12-12, 2027-02-26, 2027-04-30 |
| any other ensemble (choir, theatre) | 2026-11-06, 2027-01-29, 2027-03-26, 2027-05-07 |

| Trips on or after the registration date | Trip share |
|---|---|
| 4 | 100 percent |
| 3 | 75 percent |
| 2 | 50 percent |
| 1 | 30 percent |
| 0 | 0 percent |

**Cases on the band and orchestra trips (hypothetical registration dates).** Registered 2026-10-24: the trip that day counts, 4 trips, 100 percent. Registered 2026-12-13: 2 trips, 50 percent. Registered 2027-03-02: 1 trip, 30 percent. Registered 2027-05-01: none, 0 percent.
